about: Card 10A-1: synthetic criterion lines (inclusions) for the negated-inclusion rule. Each row's logic is built by the test: 'presence' is any-of the concept, 'value' is the latest value of an observation within a bound. 'expect' is 'held' (a person checks it) or 'runs' (the coded logic runs). 'source': p2b (review 15's two lines, public protocol text), card-v1 (this card's first table), review-1 (an adversarial review of the first version), review-j (lane J's review). Written for the test; no patient data. 'over_held' marks a row whose ideal is 'runs' but which the fail-safe holds today (a cue governs something the line does not name as a concept): counted, not hidden.
